channel.description: Recent content on Ng Fang Kiang

item.title: An Unusual Route
item.description: A candid retrospective on walking away from traditional university and corporate paths in 2016 to master engineering through full-time self-study and MOOCs.

item.title: At the Peak but Bound by Ground
item.description: How a self-taught 20-year-old from Malaysia hit #1 on MIT's DeepTraffic leaderboard, caught the eye of NVIDIA and FAANG executives, stepped back for family—and why, now unbound by geography, he is ready for the frontier.

item.title: 300km in 24 Hours - My Malaysia Ultra Solo Ride Record in Casual Gear
item.description: An unsupported 298 km solo ultra-cycling loop across Malaysia in 23h 17m on a DIY gravel bike in casual gear—proving mental grit beats elite equipment.

item.title: My Footprints
item.description: Explore an interactive map documenting travels across 34 countries, reflecting how diverse global perspectives drive vision and personal growth.

item.title: Pitch Black Detours and 2,000m+ Climbs: How I Conquered Fraser’s Hill Solo
item.description: A 20-hour, 200km solo gravel ride through pitch-black forest detours, surprise livestock encounters, pro paceline drafts, and 2,208m of climbing to Fraser's Hill—the foundational crucible that paved the way for my 300km graduation challenge.

item.title: The Hardest Online Course I Ever Took
item.description: A personal memoir on conquering the Udacity Self-Driving Car Engineer Nanodegree (SDCND) from scratch without a Computer Science degree—covering MIT DeepTraffic, sensor fusion in C++, and master's-level engineering rigor.

item.title: Why I Started This Blog
item.description: An explanation of why I started this blog to document my life's journey, structure knowledge, and own my non-traditional path.

item.title: Credits
item.description:
This blog is built with Hugo and powered by a custom fork of the PaperMod theme.

I forked PaperMod on October 4, 2026, to avoid reinventing the wheel and speed up initial development.

I have refactored the codebase to make it a completely custom configuration, specifically for my personal website.

Huge thanks to the open-source creators and contributors behind Hugo and PaperMod!

item.title: Hobbies & Passions
item.description:
Biking & Cultural Exploration

Building, riding, and discovering—my passion lies at the intersection of hands-on craftsmanship and immersive cultural exploration.

🚴‍♂️ Hardcore Craftsmanship

  • Custom Bike Build: Assembled a unique, custom gravel bike entirely from scratch—sourcing individual components, fine-tuning mechanics, and solving hands-on technical challenges.

🛣️ 10,000+ Kilometer Journey

  • Measuring Malaysia by Pedal: Logged over 10,000 kilometers across Malaysia on my self-built bike, pushing limits of endurance and navigating diverse terrains.

🏛️ Cultural Discovery on Wheels

  • Immersive History: Frequently tour ancient temples, historical museums, art exhibitions, and regional cultural events.
  • Local Connection: Use my bicycle as a gateway to connect deeply with local history, heritage, and communities along every route.

Core Strengths: Hands-on Problem Solving • Physical & Mental Endurance • Deep Cultural Curiosity

item.title: Projects
item.description: A showcase of engineering and software projects including autonomous rover navigation, real self-driving car programming, semantic segmentation, robotic arm manipulation, and global platform architecture.

item.title: Work
item.description: Detailed overview of professional career history, including building and scaling the global remote workers platform Jorcus across four platforms as a solo engineer, and providing technical code reviews and mentorship for over 140,000 students across multiple Udacity Nanodegree programs.

item.title: Looking Back at My 2021 Tech Predictions: How the Future Arrived Right on Schedule
item.description: How accurate were tech predictions from 2021? Author Ng Fang Kiang reviews five years of rapid progress in AI, automation, spatial computing, and hardware, proving that the future arrived right on schedule.

item.title: My Journey with MIT DeepTraffic: Ranking #1
item.description: Read how NG FANG KIANG achieved rank #1 in MIT’s 6.S094 DeepTraffic competition using Deep Reinforcement Learning, leading to a Udacity Self-Driving Car scholarship and high-profile industry recognition.

item.title: That Time NVIDIA AI Followed 135 Accounts on Instagram - And I Was One of Them
item.description: Discover the surreal connection between a self-taught AI enthusiast and NVIDIA AI. Explore how achieving the #1 global spot in MIT’s DeepTraffic and a Udacity SDCND scholarship caught the attention of a tech giant.
